context: A doc that copies host inventory and config defaults has drifted. A good fix makes the YAML files the only home for those values: the doc links them and names the keys instead of carrying corrected copies, while keeping the rationale, recovery, and retirement guidance the YAML cannot express.

checklist.name: Inventory owns host facts
checklist.description: docs/agents.md no longer carries a host/address list: it links inventory/agents.yaml instead. A corrected table that adds spruce or updates addresses does not earn this.

checklist.name: Config owns defaults
checklist.description: docs/agents.md links config/agent-defaults.yaml and names heartbeat_seconds and retry_limit without restating their values (no 45 or 4 copied in), so a future value change needs no Markdown edit.

checklist.name: Restart generalized
checklist.description: The per-host restart lines become one `fleetctl restart --host <host>` form that points to the inventory for host names.

checklist.name: Rationale retained
checklist.description: The heartbeat tradeoff against metered-link traffic and the bandwidth-budget check remain.

checklist.name: Recovery and retirement retained
checklist.description: The rollback command, heartbeat confirmation, remote-data warning, log export, and monitoring cleanup remain actionable.

checklist.name: Scope
checklist.description: Only docs/agents.md changes among the supplied files (a report file is optional), and no host command was run.
